title: StockSmart Supply Desk Note — Backorder Allowance Days in a Consigned Bin's Reorder Point
content:
The reorder point of a new consigned bin under the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint machines allows extra days where the item has been backordered at the program's ship-to.

**Rule.** Backorders of the transferred item opened at the program's ship-to in the last three months add allowance days: where more were opened than were filled or cancelled in those months, 3 days; where some were opened and as many or more were filled or cancelled in those months, 1 day; where none was opened, none.

**Records.** The backorder lines opened, filled and cancelled for the item on the order history of the program's ship-to, held as a Ship-To Fulfillment Account. The last three months hold rows of age below three, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month.

| Backorders opened in the window | Filled or cancelled in the window | Allowance days |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1 | 3 days (more opened than closed) |
| 2 | 2 | 1 day (some opened, as many closed) |
| 1 | 2 | 1 day (some opened, more closed) |
| 0 | 0 | none |
| 0 | 1 | none (none opened) |
